name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 5 visits over 24 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 25 hours starting 2025-12-08, at wavelengths from 1.65 to 4.89 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
